name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.RankGap.card_solutions_le
title: Rank-gap counting lemma: at most |T|^(n - rank N) solutions of N r = alpha in T^n
statement: For a matrix N in K^{m x n} over a field K, a finite set T of K and a vector alpha, the number of r in T^n with N r = alpha is at most |T|^(n - rank N). Equivalently, for r uniform on T^n, Pr[N r = alpha] <= |T|^(-rank N). This is the assumption-free step of rank-gap witness encryption (Hair-Sahai, arXiv 2609.18275, Section 3) turning a rank lower bound on the matrix space into a bound on the success of every linear test.
